Senses.Explanation: The pattern is already manifest judges that an attempted concealment has already revealed its distinctive traces. Yuanwu Keqin says the display is evident when cloud ribbons open and jade tablets unfold. Linye Tongqi says that even an attempt not to disclose the news has already given it away. The retained Zhenjing lamp uses the phrase to answer what remains visible when a turtle withdraws its six limbs.
